propositions: ADR corpus contains 91 files with only 69 distinct numbers; 17 numbers are duplicated across 22 files, causing collision-prone numbering scheme
Collision cause is primarily stale-base merges (16 of 22) rather than true races, preventable by per-number marker files that produce add/add conflicts on duplicate claims
Renumbering remediation assigns moved ADRs to 0070-0091 range in ascending landing-date order, with earliest-landed keeping original number in each collision group
Cross-references to moved ADRs are disambiguated by slug and rewritten to final numbers; bare prose references without slugs are recorded as unresolved
CI gate checks bijection between ADR files and marker files, uniqueness of all numbers, and referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug links in documentation
